sources.name: CDC web content (syndication API)
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

license.name: Public domain (U.S. Government work) with CDC use conditions
license.attribution: Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Reference to specific commercial products or companies does not constitute endorsement by CDC, HHS or the U.S. Government. This material is available at no charge on cdc.gov.
conditions: Page text: most CDC and ATSDR information 'is not subject to copyright, is in the public domain, and may be freely used or reproduced without obtaining copyright permission'

Requirement 1: attribute the agency ('Source: CDC'); requirement 2: show a non-endorsement disclaimer; requirement 3: 'You may not change the substantive content of the materials' (hence reuse_mode=quote_only); requirement 4: state that the material is otherwise available on the agency website for no charge
Exceptions: resources and images made by contractors/grantees or licensed from third parties, and works of state and local governments, may be copyrighted; images are never ingested
CDC, ATSDR and HHS logos are never used; content is taken from the CDC Content Syndication API (tools.cdc.gov/api/v2), the channel CDC offers for reuse of its pages
Occupational (NIOSH) pages and non-English items are not ingested

sources.name: CDC Vaccine Information Statements
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

license.name: Public domain (U.S. Government work) with CDC use conditions
license.attribution: Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Vaccine Information Statement. Reference to specific commercial products or companies does not constitute endorsement by CDC, HHS or the U.S. Government. This material is available at no charge on cdc.gov.
conditions: Same CDC terms as the cdc source: attribution, non-endorsement disclaimer, no change to substantive content (quote_only), statement that the material is free on cdc.gov
VIS are produced by CDC under the National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act; only the current English HTML pages on www.cdc.gov are used (translations are hosted by Immunize.org and are not ingested)
Images and logos are never ingested

license.name: Public domain (U.S. Government work); acknowledge MedlinePlus
license.attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine
conditions: Public-domain scope per the page: 'Summaries on Genetics pages, including health condition, gene, and chromosome pages and the Help Me Understand Genetics handbook' (English and Spanish)
Acknowledge MedlinePlus with 'Courtesy of MedlinePlus from the National Library of Medicine' or 'Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine'
Images and photos on Genetics pages may be copyrighted: images are never ingested
The data are best interpreted using the labeling and context of the corresponding pages on the website (geneticsdatafilesapi page)
db-key-list entries (SNOMED CT, ICD-10-CM, GTR...) are pointers only: only MeSH and OMIM identifiers are kept, as metadata, never as text

license.name: Public domain (U.S. Government work); acknowledge MedlinePlus
license.attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine
conditions: Public-domain scope per the page: homepage, summaries on health topic pages, medical test information, Genetics summaries, watermarked illustrations, recipes, videos, tutorials
Acknowledge MedlinePlus with 'Courtesy of MedlinePlus from the National Library of Medicine' or 'Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine'
A.D.A.M. Medical Encyclopedia and ASHP drug monographs are copyrighted: never ingest (medlineplus.gov/ency/, medlineplus.gov/druginfo/)
Images and photos may be copyrighted: images are never ingested
Do not use the NLM logo; do not frame or masquerade MedlinePlus URLs as another domain; RSS feeds are personal use only
xml.html: the XML files are offered for download and use; indicate that the information is from MedlinePlus.gov

sources.name: NCI PDQ cancer information summaries (patient version)

license.name: Text free of copyright (NCI Reuse of NCI Information); credit NCI
license.attribution: Source: National Cancer Institute (NCI), PDQ Cancer Information Summaries (Patient Version), cancer.gov
conditions: Page text: 'Unless otherwise indicated, all text within National Cancer Institute (NCI) products is free of copyright and may be reused without our permission. Credit the National Cancer Institute as the source.'
Digital reproduction: link to the original NCI product using its original title (citations carry the page URL and title)
Graphics may be copyrighted by third parties: images are never ingested
The NCI logo and the PDQ trademark may only be used in reproductions of original, wholly unchanged NCI products: the NCI logo is never used and excerpts must not be presented as an NCI PDQ summary
Commercial use is not addressed explicitly on the page ('free of copyright ... without our permission'); recorded as conditional
Only patient-version PDQ summaries (types/*/patient/*-pdq) are ingested; health-professional versions, Spanish pages and the 'About This PDQ Summary' section are not

sources.name: NIDDK health information
sources.publisher: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIH)

license.name: Copyright free (NIDDK copyright notice); acknowledge NIDDK
license.attribution: Source: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK), National Institutes of Health
conditions: Page text: 'The majority of information on this site is copyright free and can be freely downloaded and reproduced. Content reproduced without changes should acknowledge the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK) as the source.'

Exceptions: documents co-sponsored with private organisations (other parties may retain rights) and graphics licensed from third parties; images and logos are never ingested; pages carrying their own copyright statement are dropped by the quality gates
Edited content: NIDDK and NIH logos must be removed; content must not be used to imply endorsement of any company, product or service, or to recommend specific medical advice, treatments or referrals
Commercial use is not addressed explicitly on the page ('copyright free'); recorded as conditional
robots.txt Crawl-delay: 10 seconds is honoured; the sitemap is https://www.niddk.nih.gov/sitemap-sc.xml

license.name: Public domain, CC0 1.0 Universal dedication (FDA openFDA Terms of Service)
license.attribution: Data provided by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (https://open.fda.gov)
conditions: Terms: content and data on openFDA are public domain under CC0 1.0 'unless otherwise noted'; commercial use allowed without permission
Attribution is requested, not required; the example citation is used as the attribution line

Works where CC0 does not apply are 'clearly marked by a warning'; the drug label download carries no such marking (download.json meta: disclaimer, terms, license only); documents containing 'not in the public domain' or 'third party copy rights may apply' are dropped
The GMDN Agency notice (no AI-training use without licence) applies to device GMDN term data only; no device data is fetched
openFDA data are unvalidated and must not be relied on for medical care decisions (download.json disclaimer): labels carry jurisdiction 'US FDA label'
Right to Limit: access may be restricted if limits are circumvented; downloads use the published bulk partitions at 1 request/second
